parsedVerdict.reasoning: The unit has one file, src/models/rule.ts. It defines the abstract Rule<T> base class for portfolio rules. The class keeps the shared identity (key, languageCode) and declares the contract the subclasses implement (evaluate, getConfiguration, getName, getSettings). It also offers one shared helper, groupCurrentHoldingsByAttribute. That helper centralises the grouping and currency-conversion logic that several cluster-risk rules need. Putting it in the base class keeps that rule in one place, so subclasses don't each re-implement it. The file doesn't mix unrelated concerns. It uses its own interfaces (RuleInterface, EvaluationResult) and has no visible bypass of its abstractions. The graph shows many subclasses extending Rule consistently. The helper is slightly tangential to the pure contract, and the languageCode TODO is a small wart, but neither is a cohesion failure.
